draft_en.subject: A second ODM source for the PoE switches shipped with ESP camera kits
draft_en.body:
Hi Paul,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 28 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches shipped with ESP camera kits (Folksafe-built today), a second ODM source in ESP packaging from small lots, CE/RoHS/UKCA: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); budget unmanaged for the kit positions - 4 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-204GP - $26.2; 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-028GP - $27.2. Colour box from 200 sets.

One question: which PoE SKU do your electrical-wholesale customers reorder most - the 4-port in the kit, or the 8-port sold separately?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
